title: BSE Q1 FY27 RECORD: PAT surges 62% to Rs 872.7 Cr, revenue +63% â derivatives-driven transaction charges +80%; best quarter ever.
detail: Consolidated EBITDA margin 67% (from 65%), net margin 51%. Presentation released Aug 4 â management calls it the exchange's best quarterly performance on record.

title: Rally snapped: Sensex -210 to 78,428.95, Nifty -159 to 24,614.90 on Aug 4 â caution ahead of RBI policy; metals only gainer.
detail: Volatile session partially reversed Aug 3's CAS-driven surge. Rising crude + positioning ahead of weekly Nifty expiry added volatility. Realty and IT led the decline.

title: RBI MPC decision TODAY 10am: consensus HOLD at 5.25% for 4th straight meet â 4 of 72 economists see a HIKE, none a cut.
detail: Governor Sanjay Malhotra announces at 10am. Backdrop: resilient growth vs rising inflation, elevated crude, global uncertainty. Hawkish tilt = risk for rate-sensitives; dovish surprise = banks/NBFC/realty rally.

title: KEC International bags Rs 1,063 Cr multi-business orders â ~Rs 6,300 Cr new business since May; FY27 intake tops Rs 5,200 Cr.
detail: Orders span Civil, T&D, Renewables and Cables & Conductors. T&D capex supercycle + order-book compounding thesis intact.

title: NCC wins 3 orders worth Rs 1,052.71 Cr in July â Buildings Rs 590.38 Cr + Water Rs 462.33 Cr; stock jumps ~3%.
detail: Ex-GST value. Infra order momentum broadening across mid-cap EPC names (KEC, NCC, HG Infra all announcing).

title: SEBI restores exchange-route buybacks from Aug 1 â faster alternative to tender offers after 15-month halt.
detail: Old route halted April 2025. Expect pickup in buyback announcements from cash-rich IT and mid-caps â sentiment + EPS support.

title: NSE Q1 FY27: PAT +8.7% to Rs 3,120 Cr despite revenue -8.2%; EBITDA margin 77.9%; IPO momentum builds post-SEBI settlement.
detail: Read-across for listed capital-market plays: BSE, CDSL, AMC/broking names. NSE IPO chatter revived at ~Rs 2,000/share unlisted valuation.

detail: After WTI -5.97%/Brent -4.68% on Aug 3. OMC/paints/aviation/tyres tailwind intact but fading; $90 Brent = regime trigger to watch.

title: Nifty settles above 24,700 for first time â +1.6% to 24,774.30; Bank Nifty hits fresh high 58,247.95; IT +3% leads 4th straight up day.
detail: Sensex +544.39 (+0.70%) to 78,639.03. TCS/Infosys led IT surge; financials +1.47% on FII buying, stable credit growth, supportive RBI expectations. New Closing Auction Session (CAS) rollout drove a sharp late-session surge.

title: Crude crashes below $80: WTI -5.97% to $79.62, Brent $83.82 as Trump says Iran peace talks resume after canceled strike.
detail: Oil dropped >5% after surging 20%+ in July. Reverses the input-cost squeeze that hit Maruti and drove IOC's Rs 2,661 Cr loss. Tailwind for OMCs, paints, aviation, tyres, chemicals.

title: Dixon Technologies Q1 BLOWOUT: PAT surges 156% YoY to Rs 717.83 Cr; revenue +50% to Rs 16,076 Cr.
detail: PAT +140.9% QoQ. Electronics manufacturing scale-up + PLI momentum. Earnings call held Jul 31.

title: Indian Oil Q1 FY27: sharp swing to Rs 2,661 Cr net loss (vs Rs 11,378 Cr profit prev qtr) amid July crude volatility.
detail: Investor slides presented Aug 1. July's $100+ Brent spike drove inventory/marketing losses. Crude crashing below $80 on Aug 3 flips the driver positive for Q2.

title: FII net buy +Rs 922 Cr cash Aug 3 â but holds net short 1,50,816 index-futures contracts; profit-taking with downside cover.
detail: Cash buy streak extends: Jul 29 +2,982 Cr, Jul 30 +3,624 Cr, Jul 31 +277 Cr, Aug 3 +922 Cr. Derivatives positioning stays hedged.

title: Results week: 350+ companies report Q1 FY27 Aug 3-8 â SBI, Bharti Airtel, ONGC among them; PTC Aug 4, Cummins Aug 5.
detail: Peak earnings week. Early season read: healthy revenue/operating growth, softer PAT as costs squeeze margins â crude crash may ease that pressure from Q2.

title: Best week of July: Nifty +2.5% WoW to 24,383.60, Sensex 78,094.64 â crude easing + strong rupee + FII buying drive rebound.
detail: Nifty climbed ~600 pts in the Jul 27-31 week. Drivers: IT inflows, Bajaj Finance Q1 strength, fresh FII buying, crude sliding from $90+ to ~$88 Brent / $82 WTI as Middle East shipping lanes reopened.

title: TVS Motor Q1 RECORD: PAT surges 51% YoY to Rs 1,174 Cr, revenue +38% to Rs 13,896 Cr; all-time-high EBITDA.
detail: EBITDA Rs 1,779 Cr +41%, margin 12.8% (+30bps). 2W demand + EV (iQube) momentum confirms M&M/Bajaj auto strength.

title: GAIL Q1: Net profit jumps 96% YoY to Rs 4,670 Cr on transmission gains; total income +16% to Rs 41,482 Cr.
detail: Higher gas transmission volumes + improved marketing margins. Gas utilities benefiting even with crude ~$88.

title: Maruti Suzuki Q1: Profit slips 11% to Rs 3,352 Cr on raw-material costs despite revenue jumping 36% to Rs 52,456 Cr.
detail: EBITDA Rs 4,312 Cr (-7%). Strong volume/SUV mix but input-cost squeeze. Contrast: M&M +34%, TVS +51% â Maruti margin is the outlier.

title: KSW Energy Q1: PAT -36% to Rs 532 Cr on higher finance costs; record 1,081 MW capacity added, total 14,535 MW.
detail: Power sales -5% YoY to 12.9 BU; debt burden weighing. RE now 61% of installed base â growth capex story intact, P&L under pressure.

title: FII net BUY +Rs 277 Cr, DII net BUY +Rs 2,260 Cr on Jul 31 â both buyers again; DIIs doing the heavy lifting.
detail: FII buy streak extends: Jul 29 +2,982 Cr, Jul 30 ~+3,624 Cr, Jul 31 +277 Cr. DII +2,260 Cr Jul 31 shows domestic conviction.

title: Crude relief extends: Brent ~$88, WTI ~$82 as Middle East shipping lanes reopen; rupee firms to 95.39/USD.
detail: Down from $100+ Brent panic of Jul 23. Tailwind for OMCs, paints (Asian Paints), aviation, tyres (Balkrishna). Rupee +29 paise to 95.39.

title: Results week ahead: PTC India board Aug 4 (call Aug 5); Cummins India Q1 on Aug 5 â industrials/capex read.
detail: Early Nifty-50 season read: healthy revenue and operating-profit growth but softer net-profit growth as costs squeeze margins; industrials, autos, energy, financials strongest.

title: Sensex ROARS BACK +889 pts (+1.16%) to 77,655; Nifty +265 to 24,250 â rupee strengthens, IT flows return, FII short covering.
detail: Sharp reversal from last week's 4-session slide to 23,870. Drivers: IT sector inflows after global AI-stock correction, rupee appreciation to ~95.7/USD, FII short covering, sustained frontline buying.

title: Fed HOLDS rates â Sensex, Nifty seen positive with range-bound bias Jul 30. Crude eased to ~$85; USD/INR 95.69.
detail: Crude sharply off the $100+ Brent panic of Jul 23 â relief for OMCs, aviation, paints, chemicals. Resilient domestic earnings + improving global sentiment supporting the tape.

title: FII net BUY +Rs 2,982 Cr and DII net BUY +Rs 998 Cr Jul 29 â BOTH buyers; flow regime flipping bullish.
detail: Reversal from -2,999 Cr FII selling on Jul 23. Short covering of the 2.63L net-short index-futures position underway. Double-buyer days after double-seller days = strong regime signal.

title: Asian Paints Q1 BEAT: PAT Rs 1,539 Cr (+40% YoY), Revenue Rs 10,521 Cr (+17.9%). PBDIT margin 20.6%.
detail: Margin expansion +240bps to 20.6%. International net sales +27.2% (Egypt, UAE, Oman, Nepal, Bangladesh); intl PBT +94.9%. Crude easing = further input-cost tailwind for paints.

title: Balkrishna Industries Q1: PAT jumps 56% YoY to Rs 451 Cr; Rs 4/share dividend declared.
detail: Revenue Rs 3,455 Cr +25.2% YoY. Off-highway tyre (agri/OTR) export demand strong.

title: Waaree Energies Q1: Revenue +79% to Rs 7,932 Cr, PAT +14% to Rs 850 Cr, EBITDA +44% to Rs 1,440 Cr.
detail: Solar manufacturing scale-up on track. US arm won 236 MW Kentucky module supply (Jun 30). PAT growth lagging revenue = margin compression to watch.

title: Bajaj Housing Finance Q1: PAT +23% to Rs 715 Cr; AUM crosses Rs 1.49 L Cr (+24%); record disbursements.
detail: Record quarterly AUM addition Rs 8,918 Cr, all-time-high disbursements Rs 19,509 Cr. NII +9% vs AUM +24% = margin pressure to monitor.

title: KPIT Technologies Q1 WEAK: PAT -28% QoQ to Rs 117 Cr; revenue slips 2.1% QoQ to Rs 1,675 Cr.
detail: Auto ER&D demand soft. IT tape stays selective post-Infosys guide cut â engineering services not immune.
